title: Getting Started with World Blue International Checking
summary: This document covers getting started with World Blue International Checking, including the $10,000 minimum balance requirement, $50.00 monthly maintenance fee, support for up to 35 currencies, and payment sending/receiving in $140 supported regions. It outlines initial setup steps (funding, adding currency wallets, setting a primary operating currency, configuring payee profiles, assigning user access/permissions) and first-week best practices, plus referral eligibility for Rho-Bank holders (90 days active; referred business opens an account and deposits $25,000 within 90 days).
